title: Training approvals
text: Training requests require manager approval before enrolment. The training budget cap is R1500 per employee per course. A request above R1500 must be escalated and cannot be created by this prototype.

title: Skills development
text: Recommend training based on documented role requirements and demonstrated skills gaps. Training recommendations are not performance ratings or employment decisions.

title: Data privacy
text: Only use synthetic employee data in demos. Do not infer sensitive characteristics, rank employees, or make hiring, dismissal or disciplinary decisions.

title: Workplace safety
text: Safety training must be completed before employees perform restricted site tasks. Escalate uncertainty to a human supervisor.
